market.rules_primary: If the number of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch is above 50 from Nov 9, 2026 to Nov 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary: The total is calculated by summing daily counts from Nov 9, 2026 to Nov 15, 2026. The market will resolve no earlier than Tuesday at 9 AM following the end of the period, once complete data is available.
market.title: Will there be more than 50 transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz from Nov 9, 2026 to Nov 15, 2026?
